reason: All 27 bills are 'toward' and about widening access to higher education: abolishing psychometric/entrance exam requirements, banning age limits, admission relief, and founding universities/colleges in the north, Negev, Ashdod, Eilat and Arab towns. The statement names both mechanisms as examples of one idea (more accessible higher education) and the price (lower academic standards) fits both, so splitting would only create two thin directions backed by the same sponsors.
